core_obligations: Descend to the affine situation and express nonreducedness of the generic fibre by an explicit nilpotent element.
Spread that witness to a nonempty open using finite presentation, so every fibre over the open is nonreduced.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the affine case and choose a witness of nonreducedness on the generic fibre.
Use finite presentation to spread the witness to a neighbourhood.
Conclude nonreducedness of every fibre over the open.

difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, nonreducedness of the fibre over the generic point forces nonreducedness of every fibre over a nonempty open. The proof descends to the affine situation, expresses nonreducedness of the generic fibre as the vanishing of a nilpotent on the generic fibre, and then spreads that nilpotent to a neighbourhood using finite presentation of the relevant algebra, so that the same witness of nonreducedness occurs in every fibre over the open. Producing a single witness that survives the spread is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7117-7158.
